title: CoreWeave's stock and unsecured bonds fall after sweeping Democratic midterm victories, as Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa calls for a data center moratorium (Katherine Schwartz/Bloomberg)
summary: Katherine Schwartz / Bloomberg: CoreWeave's stock and unsecured bonds fall after sweeping Democratic midterm victories, as Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa calls for a data center moratorium — CoreWeave Inc.'s bonds tumbled on Wednesday, in some cases to new lows, after Democratic candidates in favor of slowing …
